title: Templates
description: Available website templates and what each includes.

blocks.text: Templates are full Next.js 16 apps with admin portal, Prisma + MariaDB, lead capture, optional FTP uploads, and Docker Compose for local database.

items: Flat copy into current directory (no nested template folder)

Admin at /admin with ADMIN_USER / ADMIN_PASSWORD from .env

GETTING_STARTED.md linear checklist in the project
